desc:
🃏 Draw cards to make money, stack perks and rebirth for a permanent multiplier!

✨ FEATURES
🎁 100+ perks from packs
⚡ Auto-draw: The Dealer draws for you
👑 A boss fight at every rebirth
💤 Idle income: earn coins even while offline
🏆 Global and friends leaderboards

🔥 HOW TO PLAY
1. Tap or click the deck to draw cards
2. Buy upgrades
3. Open packs and equip perks
4. Beat the boss to rebirth
5. Rebirth again, faster

💬 Report bugs and share feedback in our Community Server. Link on the game page (16+).

🎨 Card art: "8-Bit" by drawsgood, "8-Bit Classic" by Kajiru, "Cute Bear" by YY Game, "Cursed" and "Enchanted" by FagelTomten, "Black (g)" by Androx. Icons by gvesster. Effects by Pozac.
